name: elixis
description: Naming and identity direction from source material, through a local MCP server. Extract entities and patterns from a Source Corpus, research and synthesize name candidates, translate expression DNA, and assemble Market Kits. Nine tools over stdio - create_soul, run_game, extract_entities, analyze_patterns, translate_text, research_name, name_from_identity, ingest_source, create_market_kit - served by `python3 -m elixis.mcp_server` from the plugin root. Python 3.12+, standard library only, nothing to pip install. Optional LLM enrichment via LLM_BASE_URL / LLM_API_KEY / LLM_MODEL (defaults to local Ollama at http://localhost:11434); without a reachable LLM seven of the nine tools still succeed with keyword-only patterns and empty name variants - degraded mode, not a defect. Disclosure - makes network calls only to the configured LLM endpoint; keeps local state and logs under .elixis/ inside its plugin directory; reads no other credentials; the bundled elixis skill documents the CLI and HTTP surfaces.
